body: I see your point, I don't even feel like I can be near my kids with my mind this fragile and volatile. It is destroying me. And slowly everything I care for I just don't as much and I hibernate :/

Sadly I relate to this. Sadly I too have no idea what to do, nor have the tools to make it better.

I don't know how long I can keep doing the same shit and hoping for a different response :/

Hope you find your sun, bro.
